notes.title: New Version Arrives
notes.content:
New Version Update 🔥

https://i.imgur.com/PaiTd24.png

Dear Strikers,

Battle Teams will enter the new version 1.46 update for American servers on July 31 at 10:00 AM Beijing Time / 11:00 PM CDT for over 4–5 hours. 🕛 During this time, servers will be closed and you cannot login to the game. If maintenance is completed sooner than expected, the game will be available to login.

https://i.imgur.com/Om2Ug7S.png

What to expect in the next coming version? 

1. Dimensional Rift – Mirage Citadel Final Stage is open

The Mirage Citadel arc concludes with a visually stunning and challenging finally stage for neon city packed with chaotic boss phases and cinematic intensity.


https://i.imgur.com/9pkOmoH.png

2. Main Story Chapter 3 – Rapid Extreme Mode

Experience Chapter 3 in Rapid Mode with increased difficulty, faster combat pacing, and greatly enhanced drop rewards, giving high tier players to test how far their damage can reach. 


https://i.imgur.com/mME25oc.png

3. Gun Spirit Dispatch Center

Assign your Gun Spirits to passive missions that collect loot automatically, helping you stay rewarded even while offline.


You can join the Dispatch center from the Dim Chasm or from your Battlefield lobby: 

https://i.imgur.com/iOlseCr.png

https://i.imgur.com/W0Mcgj8.png

You can expend the section below for more information, Details will be posted on a discord article: 

[expand=📦 Dispatch System – Full Auto Rewards Mode]
The Dispatch Agency is a system that lets you assign Gun Spirits to auto-clear Special 5 difficulty stages in the main storyline, earning rewards over time without manual play. It helps reduce repetitive grinding and lets players focus on more interesting content. Access it from the battlefield in Adventure Mode (below Recon icon) or from inside Dimensional Rift stages.

At first, you can dispatch 1 Gun Spirit to level 1 missions. As the Dispatch Station upgrades (up to Lv19), it unlocks more chapters (Maya, Desert, Hell, Islands), adds more dispatch teams (up to 3), increases team capacity, and boosts speed (up to +100%). Upgrades require Dispatch Experience, earned by collecting new Gun Spirits and relics — higher rarity gives more points, with a current total max of 12,360 XP (up to Lv17). 

Missions require prior manual Expert-clear, specific Gun Spirit stars (1★ to 5★ based on chapter), stamina, and silver. Dispatch shares a weekly 100-run cap with Expert 5, and rewards relics, and even rare qualification gems. Players are advised to follow strategies like prioritizing high-chapter missions first, using “Auto Arrange,” and clicking each level to test Gun Spirit fit. Although collecting and upgrading Gun Spirits costs gold, the returns in rare resources and time-saving make Dispatch a powerful system — especially in later chapters. Start early or risk falling behind.
[/expand]

https://i.imgur.com/G5xkjnH.png


4. Speed Mode Chapter 2

A harder version of Chapter 2 is here with enhanced AI behavior and increased item drops for players who dare to enter.


https://i.imgur.com/7XAPoOV.png

5. Dimensional Chasm – Maze Treasure Hunt

Traverse a mysterious underground labyrinth filled with traps, puzzles, and rare rewards in this limited-time maze expedition.


https://i.imgur.com/Tmuo5ST.png

Some information can be found by expending the tab below, more details will be shared on discord article. 
[expand=🐉 Dragon Tomb (Dimensional Rift Chapter 2) – Full Mechanics Overview]
Dragon Tomb is Chapter 2 of the Dimensional Rift, featuring 6 stages. Clearing each stage unlocks the next. You get 10 attempts per stage weekly (each costs 300 stamina), reset every Saturday. No rewards if you exceed the count or lack stamina. Gun Spirits can assist, but there are no normal/hard modes or side paths.

Each stage randomly spawns four types of treasure chests (green, blue, yellow, red). The first three are guaranteed; red is rare and hidden. Max 3 chest waves per stage. To open them, you need 100% “Energy Value”: killing mobs gives 50%, killing the boss gives the other 50%. Chests have 100 HP and will break if enemies attack them too much.

Higher “Danger Level” boosts enemy strength and rewards. Red chests and Treasure Rats have spawn probabilities shown on the mini-map. Treasure Rats are high-reward mobs that don’t attack, have low HP, and drop rare items. Up to 3 can appear per run, surviving 5 minutes max.

Each boss has unique mechanics:  
• Xing Tian disables healing and attack buffs  
• White Bone Lady self-heals  
• Demon Dragon causes stuns  
• Spider Queen heals but is weaker  
• Green Snake summons clones and needs Corrosion weapons to break shields  
• Blood Puppet has high HP and strong damage, supported by elite mobs

Recommended weapons: use Yin-Yang or Corrosion types like Oracle, Moyun, or Arc Flash for shield-breaking.  
Accessory synergy:  
• “Tiger Claw” boosts red chest & rat spawn rate  
• “Golden Umbrella” speeds up energy gain and reduces damage  
• “Mojin Charm” increases Danger Level and red chest chances  
• “Oracle” weapons improve collector HP and suppress interfering mobs

**Gameplay Strategy:**  
• Beginners: focus on green chests, ignore rats  
• Intermediate: aim for blue chests and raise Danger to trigger rats  
• Advanced: wear epic Tiger Claw and farm 3-red/3-rat farming teams

**Collectibles:** 4 series, 6 quality levels each. Just to get all Silver-quality collectibles requires ~1,042 clears (60/week → 17 weeks minimum). Grind level is as high as Expert collectibles.

Also includes the permanent “Dragon Treasure Hunt” event: 6-week duration, 10 free entries/week (60 total), with optional paid tries. Treasure Hunt simplifies gameplay: opening a chest triggers the boss instantly. Red chests drop Hunt Tokens to exchange for rare items like chips and collectibles.
[/expand]

6. New Competitive Mode – Peak League 1v1

Face off in intense 1v1 elimination brackets with weapon bans, loadout picks, and strategic matchups.
Top 512 players qualify for finals. Earn Peak Tokens to craft limited items like Peak Dragon Wings.
Spectators can vote and earn rewards!


Click below for some information

[expand=🥊 Peak League Tournament – Competitive 1v1 Showdown]
The Peak League (乱斗巅峰赛) is a 1v1 single-elimination PvP tournament. Players progress through regional qualifiers toward a 512-player final bracket. Matches follow a double-elimination format and best-of-three rules.

Each round includes weapon bans and strategic loadout selections. Peak Tokens earned during the tournament can unlock exclusive cosmetic items like Peak Dragon Wings. A test season ran May 10–31, and the official launch began June 7. Spectators can vote for players to gain bonus rewards.
[/expand]

7. Chapter 4 Desert – Extreme Rapid Mode

Extreme Rapid Mode returns for Chapter 4, featuring faster-paced enemies and elite-tier drop rates for high-end players.

Ready to show of your power ? 

https://i.imgur.com/kkReVVo.png


8. Adventure Event – Return to Base (Ranked)

Battle across 3 ranked lanes (Black Iron → Gold), facing waves of enemies under a time-attack system.
Earn ranking points to climb the leaderboard and unlock sharpshooter  cores, resets, slot unlockers, and more.


[expand=🏆 Return to Base – Ranked Adventure Event Details]
Return to Base features three challenge lanes with increasing difficulty and quality (Black Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold). You fight timed waves of enemies, including a final boss—defeating it quickly boosts your score.

Rewards are based on waves cleared and lane difficulty. Players can use slot unlockers and resets (purchased with gold) to increase attempts and push higher rankings. Daily attempts refresh, and global milestones allow everyone to claim stage rewards. Top players receive exclusive items such as Gun God cores and advanced proficiency gear.
[/expand]

https://i.imgur.com/U4IimxN.png

9. Eternal Realm – Solo PvE Progression Mode

Daily free entry into a new single-player challenge mode with rising difficulty.
Progress to Stage 22+ to unlock shared resource points across servers.


[expand=⛰️ Eternal Realm – Solo PvE Overview]
Eternal Realm is a new single-player challenge mode where you enter daily for free. After the first run, you’ll need Eternal Keys to continue, with increasing cost per stage.

Each cleared stage grants better rewards. Reaching Stage 22 unlocks cross-server resource points, which players can fight over to gain shared bonuses. The mode resets daily, with no penalty for failure—just keep climbing!
[/expand]

10. Road to Sharpshooter Extended

Huge Energy Strength Boost
Huge Crit Chance and Crit Damage boost


https://i.imgur.com/cgRZnXI.png

11. Dimensional Chasm – Iron Mace Phantom 

A twisted new Chapter 3 Research Base dungeon introduces fresh rules, enemies and boss mechanics.
Difficulty and rewards scale via “scrolling stats” — no Normal/Hard/Nightmare tiers like before.
Clears follow a randomized challenge system. High-end modifiers like attribute bars and Yin‑Yang shields can appear, requiring special weapon types to overcome.
Unlocks 5 runs per week. Drops include holographic gems, adventure resources, and four unique collectible series (each with 6 tiers) that boost offense, defense, crit and shields.


https://i.imgur.com/fqdQDxK.png

Click to expand for some mechanics details:

[expand=🧪 Iron Mace Phantom – Rift Chapter 3 Full Mechanics]
Iron Mace Phantom (铁城幽影) is the third chapter of Dimensional Rift. It introduces new enemies and boss mechanics. Like the “Return to Base” event, it uses a challenge progression system: higher difficulty modifiers yield better drops—no fixed difficulty levels. This includes attribute health bars and Yin‑Yang shields instead of just increased HP. Without special weapons, even low-tier modifiers can block progression .

You get **5 entry attempts per week**. Rewards include holographic gems, adventure resources, and four collectible sets (each with six quality levels). Activated collectibles grant strong stats like penetration, shield strength, crit damage, and general combat power—making Iron Mace Phantom a major farming hotspot after Dragon Tomb.
[/expand]

https://i.imgur.com/wyrdk7r.png

12. Extreme Talent – Load Value System 

Equip powerful Load Skills unlocked through weapon reconstruction.
Manage your total Load Value pool strategically — each skill consumes points based on its strength.
Increase your Load capacity by upgrading weapons and reaching VIP milestones.


https://i.imgur.com/rOg7uXx.png

[expand=⚙️ Load Value – Extreme Talent System Explained]
The Load Value (负荷值) system is the foundation for the Extreme Talent feature, allowing you to equip powerful skills known as Load Skills after reconstructing (rebirthing) your weapon.

Each Load Skill requires a number of Load Points. Your total Load Value starts at 50 and increases based on various upgrades:

• Golden Weapon: +2 pts  
• Hero Weapon (1st upgrade): +1 pt  
• VIP Lv8: +12 pts  
• Hero gear and more also add bonuses

To equip Load Skills, your total selected skills must not exceed your Load Value. This forces you to make smart trade-offs between power and point cost, allowing for customized talent builds based on your gear progression.
[/expand]


13. New Enhancement – Divine Forge for Character Gear

A new gear progression system is now available for characters in Adventure Mode.
Unlock Divine Forge once all 4 gear pieces reach max level in Enhance, Modify, and Advance.
Greatly boosts stats and unlocks the “Stigmata” socket system.


https://i.imgur.com/GSpEYGb.png

[expand=⚙️ Divine Forge – Full Mechanics (100% from CN source)]
Once a character’s four gear parts reach full level in Enhance (强化), Modify (改造), and Advance (进阶), the Divine Forge (神锻) system becomes available in Adventure Mode.

• Forge (锻造): Consume materials to increase equipment stats.  
• Divinize (神化): Raise the stat cap by upgrading the Forge tier (may reduce current level slightly).  
Both steps enhance attributes significantly.

You can access Divine Forge from your character circle in Adventure, or via the “Workshop” in the camp lobby.

Stigmata System (圣痕):  
• Each gear piece has a Stigmata socket.  
• Socketed Stigmata grant additional attributes.  
• The number and value of Stigmata attributes depend on the gear’s Divine Forge level.  
• Stigmata can be acquired using appraisal items (鉴定器) on raw Stigmata stones.

Material Sources:  
• T2 Forge Stones drop from Lv.4+ chests in DLC chapter “Iron Mace Phantom”  
• T1 Forge Stone Packs can be purchased in the Discount Mall and may contain A- or B-type materials.
[/expand]

14. Adventure Event – Greed Altar (Preheat)

Exclusive solo Adventure Mode event launching ahead of the 11th Anniversary.
Enter through the lobby under the King’s Brawl section.


[expand=⚠️ Greed Altar Preheat – Mechanics & Timeline]
This is a solo-only Adventure Mode preheat event called Greed Altar, leading into the upcoming anniversary update.



• Mode Type: Solo play only — no co-op allowed  
• Challenge Tickets: Extra entries can be bought using altar charms from the gold shop  

Difficulty Levels: Normal, Hard, Nightmare — harder modes cost more entries and give better rewards.  
Rewards: Each clear grants Ritual Tokens (仪式火种), used in the exclusive event shop for valuable loot.

This preheat version previews mechanics and content coming in the full 11th Anniversary event, including tougher bosses, blood sacrifice features, and more.
[/expand]

https://i.imgur.com/WenCHnc.png



15. Divine Forge – Stigmata System 

Gear pool expanded with divine-tier enhancements and Stigmata customization.
Stigmata are socketed on max‑forged equipment and provide powerful stat bonuses.
Saint Stones (圣痕原石) drop from Greed Altar or event shops, then turned into Stigmata with appraisal items.


[expand=🧬 Stigmata Mechanics – Official CN Update]
Stigmata (圣痕) unlock after using the Divine Forge (装备神锻) system:

• Once an item’s Enhance, Modify, and Advance levels are maxed, the Forge system is unlocked
• In the Forge menu, each gear has a Stigmata socket. Click below the gear to open the Stigmata page. 
• Socketed Stigmata grant attribute bonuses. Their number and strength depend on your gear’s forge level.
• Stigmata are created from appraisal of Saint Stones (圣痕原石·Ⅰ/Ⅱ), which drop from Greed Altar or event shops.
• Stone types match equipment slots (e.g. Armor, Gloves, Detector, Field), and artifact-only Stigmata can only be socketed into their respective slot.
• Saint Stones yield Stigmata with 1–2 or 1–3 random stats (depending on rank I or II). 
• Some stats have set bonuses—e.g. “Solo,” “Twin,” “Trinity,” “Quad,” or conditional triggers like energy threshold, weapon collection count, or activated collectible count. 
[/expand]


16. Armed Assault – New Stage: Omnic Crisis 

A brand-new large-scale raid boss: AI Girl (AI少女) enters the battlefield.
Up to 10 players can team up to challenge this high-intensity boss.
Expect massive AoE attacks, healing abilities, and instant-kill mechanics—survival depends on team coordination.
Greatly increased emblem drop rate for redeeming shop resources.


[expand=🤖 Omnic Crisis – Full Raid Overview]
Omnic Crisis (智械危机) is the latest Armed Raid stage featuring a brand-new boss: AI Girl. This large-scale PvE fight allows up to 10 players to cooperate in real-time.

The boss features:
• Massive AoE skills  
• Self-healing mechanics  
• Instant-kill (秒杀) attacks  
• High durability and pressure

Only coordinated players will survive. This mode also offers more currency than previous raids—perfect for shop exchange and progression.

This is currently the hardest challenge in Armed Raid and is ideal for maxed-out loadouts.
[/expand]

https://i.imgur.com/1oY6J9d.png


17. Armed Assault– New Global Difficulty: Expert Mode

A new “Expert” difficulty level has been added to Armed Raid mode.

https://i.imgur.com/JQSMqt4.jpeg

[expand=🔥 Greed Altar – Full Event Features]
The Greed Altar is the core event for the 11th Anniversary. Compared to the preheat, this full version adds:

• More rewards  
• Expanded mechanics  
• New battle effects, elite enemies, and powerful negative buffs  

Key Details:  
• Get 25 entries at launch + 10 weekly on Saturdays

Rewards:

This is the most advanced and brutal solo event ever added. Perfect for experienced players and collectors.

20. Divine & Chaotic Chips – VR Dragoon System
Master these SSS-tier chips to enhance survivability, burst potential, and PvE dominance.


🎯 These chips are divided into two families: Chaotic  and Divine. Each chip belongs to a role—Support, Attack, or Defense—and synergizes within its type.



⚔️ Chaotic Chip Set

https://i.imgur.com/BgkinjX.png



Chaotic Blast (Support/Active) – Charges up then unleashes a powerful AoE field, greatly increasing energy strength and dealing heavy damage over time. Restores Chaotic Power with each enemy hit.
Chaotic Origin (Support/Passive) – Generates 70% Chaotic Power at key phases (death/revival/start), then converts energy into damage when it changes.
Chaotic Mark (Attack/Passive) – Marks enemies on hit. Marked targets take bonus Dragoon damage and recover Chaotic Power when hit again.
Chaotic Block (Defense/Passive) – Grants massive damage reduction and Chaotic Power when hit from long range. Trigger chance scales by distance.


🛡️ Divine Chip Set

https://i.imgur.com/ADHIa2o.png


Divine Blast (Support/Active) – Boosts energy regen and penetration. Each energy used restores HP, energy, and slightly extends duration.
Holy Source (Support/Passive) – Continuously generates Holy Sacred Power over time and from kills. Essential for energy sustain.
Holy Heart (Attack/Passive) – For every 300 points of Holy Power stacked by 1 stack, the player gains the following effect: 10% damage bonus, 20% movement speed bonus
Holy Reincarnation (Defense/Passive) – When HP drops below 50%, consumes power to block the hit and grants 3 seconds of invincibility.


🎒 Chip Bags & Ranks

https://i.imgur.com/7FixpaD.png

https://i.imgur.com/f7QV64q.png


Chaotic Chip Bag – Grants random Chaotic chip; General and Elite versions can yield up to S-rank, while Supreme bags can yield SSS-rank (Red).
Divine Chip Bag – Same system applies; used to obtain random Divine chips with ranking tied to bag type.


https://i.imgur.com/GFinSBm.png



💡 Pro Tip: Build synergy: Combine Support + Attack or Defense chips from the same family. Chaotic excels at burst and debuffing; Divine focuses on healing, resistance, and survival.

[hr][/hr]

Chaotic Chip at Max Level can deal massive damage allowing you to clear 2-3 floors in Arena using Dragoon Only.

22. Fuel Attribute System – Passive Boss Resistance
Weapons now contribute hidden Fuel Attributes that passively reduce boss buffs in PvE fights.


📌 Each weapon has Fuel Attributes that accumulate in your account’s attribute pool.

These resistance points reduce boss BUFF effects during combat:

[color=red]Hardened Skin[/color] – Reduces damage taken. Unreduced layers = higher incoming damage.
[color=purple]Kinetic Reduction[/color] – Reduces boss Crit Rate. Unreduced layers = higher chance to be crit.
[color=blue]Impact[/color] – Reduces boss Crit DMG. Unreduced layers = higher crit multiplier.
[color=green]HP Contamination[/color] – Increases your shield regen. Unreduced layers = reduced recovery.
[color=orange]Strength Enhance[/color] – Reduces boss ATK buff. Unreduced layers = higher boss DMG output.
[color=darkred]Life Absorption[/color] – Prevents boss from dealing lifesteal-type damage.



https://i.imgur.com/Jlvy9M3.png

🔸 How it works:

Each weapon adds 1–2 points to specific attributes shown in the fuel icon tab.
Total points stack across your loadout and contribute globally.
More resistance layers = less risk from boss-enhanced mechanics.

notes.title: Essense of the Ink
notes.content:
The battlefield is about to witness art in motion.  
Introducing Essence of the Ink Combine, a legendary war fan infused with the fluid power of ink magic!  
Wield elegance and destruction in perfect harmony as you paint your path to victory. 🌸  

https://i.imgur.com/y9x5e3P.png

Duration: 28 February - Permanent ⏳  

Playing the new legendary melee is simple and includes 4 main parts:  

- Factory: Obtain the weapon in V0 and V1 with some sidekicks ➜ Cost: 12,600 Gold  
- Forging Crystal Event: Cost: 26k - 32k Gold ➜ Allows you to reach Level 2 Legendary Form  
- Maxing the weapon: The most expensive part ➜ Up to 257,000 Gold  
- Collection Boosters: Final investment ➜ Up to 423,000 Gold  

More than expensive, right? The good thing is the event is permanent, meaning you can max it over time by recharging for other stuff. Plus, we will carry you up with some discounts!  

Let's dive into it! 🔥  

✍️ Part 1: Event Overview

1.1 Essence Factory

The acquisition of Ink Legend melee is similar to the previous legendary Star-shatter.  
First, you have to collect Heart of the Essence, totaling 12,600 Hearts, costing 12,600 Gold.  

Formula: For every 400 Gold recharge, you can buy 500 Hearts for 500 Gold by clicking on the "+" sign at the top left.  

https://i.imgur.com/nFdRCEx.png

Factory Formula:

1.2  Spirit Legendary Crystal ✨

As with any other legendary, you must join a lucky draw 🎲, which grants you a chance to win a crystal that allows you to reach the legendary form of the new melee.  

https://i.imgur.com/ofjMJS9.png

This will cost between 26k and 32k gold 💰, worst case based on luck. The price can be reduced by using x10 draw tickets, which can be received for free through Hot Events, Expert Rush, and other online missions.

1.3 🎨 Design 

Essence of the Ink is a folding fan with a strong traditional Chinese style! 🏮✨  
It features a great design and attractive effects.  

https://i.imgur.com/KIzD114.png  
https://i.imgur.com/KoRcGXw.png  
https://i.imgur.com/BRbkRVv.png  

📸 Here an HD picture of the fan:  

https://i.imgur.com/YuI6px5.png  
https://i.imgur.com/xqhl14A.png  

🤔 But wait… there's a lot more! Even though the melee has one visual for all evolution levels, where did all these variations come from?  

Let's dig into its features! 🔍  

🎭 Part 2: Skills and Features

2.1 Effect 🌸

A soul skill that Ink has possessed since birth. It is a characteristic of weapons that advances with damage/kills in battle.  

It is said that the Ink appearance does not change in the three stages. However, in reality, this legendary fan does change during battle.  

If you switch between forms, you may think they all look the same, but **this is not true**!  
The PNGs above (and we haven’t even shown them all!) prove the rare design this legendary fan offers. 🔥  

https://i.imgur.com/sQz5hAr.png

After entering the battle, when holding the weapon, a progress bar and symbols representing the four forms of Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, and Chrysanthemum 🌸🎋 will appear in the middle of the screen.  

Every time all the weapons in the current backpack cause damage, the progress bar will increase.  
When the progress bar is full, the icon above will light up ✨, allowing the Ink Blade to enter the next level! 🔥

https://i.imgur.com/A6RSsau.png

The energy required to fill the progress bar 📊 increases as you advance.  
Transitioning from Plum → Orchid requires just one kill ☠️, while Orchid → Bamboo and Bamboo → Chrysan each require two kills in competitive modes.  

Every time a phase is unlocked, Essence of the Ink retains the abilities of all previous forms.  
For example, once Bamboo is unlocked, the weapon simultaneously holds the traits of Plum, Orchid, and Bamboo.  

Upon reaching its final form, Chrysan 🌼, the progress bar starts depleting ⏳.  
After 15 seconds, it fully drains, reverting the weapon back to Plum.  
This means the final form lasts for a total of 15 seconds.  

If the player dies before reaching full power, they lose one phase, and the energy bar resets 🔄.  
For example, dying in the Bamboo phase results in reviving at the Orchid phase with an empty progress bar.  

However, once the weapon reaches its fully developed state (Essence of the Ink - Unified) ⚡,  
death no longer causes phase downgrades. 🔥

2.2 Ink Spirit ❤️‍🔥

Ink Spirit is the primary damage mechanism of Essence of the Ink in Mutation, Challenge, and Adventure Modes.  

It has four forms:  
- Ink Spirit - Initial includes Plum and Orchid forms. 🌸  
- Ink Spirit - Rise adds the Bamboo form. 🎋  
- Ink Spirit - Unified introduces the Chrysan form. 🌼  

https://i.imgur.com/s95KFSm.png

🌸 Plum Form  

When Essence of the Ink attacks, a Plum Branch appears at the crosshair, dealing damage to the target. 🎯  

https://i.imgur.com/KxfTdRN.png

The Plum Branch deals AoE damage and can trigger critical hits. 💥  

- In Adventure Mode, the area of effect is large. 🌍  
- In Competitive Mode, the area is much smaller. 🎯  

https://i.imgur.com/6uGdkOO.png

🌼 Orchid Form  

When any weapon in your current backpack deals damage, a yellow orchid spawns at the player’s feet.  

- The Orchid slowly moves forward and expands.  
- Standing inside it grants a damage reduction effect. 🛡️  

At first, this damage reduction isn't very practical because:  
1. The Orchid is small and doesn't last long. ⏳  
2. Since it moves slowly in one direction, it's hard to stay inside it. 🏃‍♂️  

https://i.imgur.com/i3OqFpJ.png

However, once the Orchid reaches MAX, it turns blue 🔵 and automatically follows the player, making it much more useful:  

- Auto-follows the player. 🚶‍♂️💠  
- Increased damage reduction. 🛡️  
- Restores HP upon killing enemies. ❤️‍🩹  

https://i.imgur.com/iyQGit0.png

🎋 Bamboo Form (Unlocked at Ink Spirit - Rise)  

When holding Essence of the Ink, the weapon automatically selects the nearest enemy at intervals 🎯 (in Mutation Mode, targets must be within sight 👀).  

- After a short delay, it triggers "Broken Bamboo" at the target's location, dealing damage. 💥  
- The target is briefly stunned. ⚡  
- The stun effect has a cooldown between activations. ⏳  

https://i.imgur.com/am0RaS6.png

This form acts as a background attack, meaning:  
- It triggers frequently. 🔄  
- It auto-aims at enemies. 🎯  
- In Adventure Mode, it can target any enemy in the scene. ⚔️  
- In Mutation Mode, it only targets enemies within the player's vision. 👀  

🌼 Chrysan Form (Unlocked at Ink Spirit - Unified)  

The Chrysan Form is a buff form that enhances the effects of Plum, Orchid, and Bamboo.  

1. Removes the damage delay from Plum Branch and Broken Bamboo, making them deal instant damage upon activation. ⚡  
2. When an Orchid spawns, it immediately appears at MAX level (blue form) and auto-follows the player. 🔵🏃‍♂️  
3. Increases the damage of all weapons in the player's backpack while active. 💥🔥  

2.3 Ink Soul 🎭  

Ink Soul is the core mechanic of Essence of the Ink in Knife Fight, Blade, and Big Head Knife Fight Modes.  

① 🌸 Plum Form  

When performing a left-click attack, there is a chance to generate a Plum Branch at the crosshair position.  

- After a brief delay, it deals 51 damage. 💥  
- If the Plum Branch doesn’t trigger, the damage of the left-click attack increases. 🔺  
- The damage boost can stack. 📈  
- This resets once the Plum Branch triggers. 🔄  

The Plum Branch activation is random—sometimes it triggers within a few hits, other times it takes many attempts, making it unpredictable. 🎲  

https://i.imgur.com/hF9spq8.png

② 🌼 Orchid Form  

When performing a right-click heavy attack, a Blade Light remains on the battlefield.  

- The Blade Light deals continuous damage while active. ⚔️  
- Each hit deals 15 damage. 💥  
- The number of Blade Lights is limited to 2 active at a time. 🔢  

⚠ Important:  
If 2 Blade Lights are already present, a new one won’t trigger until an existing one disappears.  
This limitation can be frustrating, especially when you need it but it doesn’t activate due to the limit. 😤  

https://i.imgur.com/TdrGRBK.png

③ 🎋 Bamboo Form  

After killing an enemy, the weapon triggers the MAX status of Blessing of Ink Spirit.  

- While active, it blocks multiple hits from outside the Ink Spirit zone. 🛡️  
- Testing suggests it can block up to 3 hits. 🔄  

🔥 Why is this useful?  
This defensive mechanic is highly effective, especially against long-range knife attacks, since those attacks often have hit limits. 🎯  

④ 🌼 Chrysan Form  

- Reduces the damage delay of Plum Branch, making it more responsive. ⚡  
- While standing inside the Blessing of Ink Spirit zone, HP is continuously restored. ❤️‍🩹  
2.4 Pure Essence 🪽  

[Phase 1 Unlock]  
In Mutation, Challenge, Adventure, Knife Fight, Blade, and Big Head Knife Fight modes, when advancing forms, there is a chance to skip a phase, counting as a full cycle.  

This mechanic is easy to understand, but in practice, Plum → Orchid never seems to skip.  
However, Orchid → Bamboo often skips directly to Chrysan instead. 🎭  

2.5 Ink Mark 🗡️  

Unlocked at Phase 2 in Mutation, Challenge, and Adventure Modes.  

- Completing a full Plum → Orchid → Bamboo → Chrysan cycle grants one Ink Painting (max storage: 2 paintings). 🎨  

https://i.imgur.com/g3DAg2w.png

🌪️ Wind and Rain Summoning  

- Press "E" to consume 1 Ink Painting and activate Wind and Rain Summoning  
  (*in Adventure Mode, it consumes energy instead*). ⚡  

- Creates a storm zone at the crosshair location 🌩️ (*limited to a certain number of active zones*).  

- Enemies inside the zone suffer:  
  - Continuous damage 💥  
  - Slow effect 🐌  
  - Reduced energy crit rate ⬇️⚡  
  - Pulled into the zone from nearby areas 🌪️  

https://i.imgur.com/zqNcDtd.png

💡 Instant Chrysan Upgrade:  
- If not already in Chrysan form, activating Wind and Rain Summoning immediately upgrades to Chrysan.  
- This does not grant an Ink Painting when triggered.  

The Ultimate Ability  

This is Essence of the Ink’s only active skill, featuring:  
✅ Continuous damage  
✅ Enemy slow  
✅ Enemy pull effect  
✅ Crit rate reduction  

When the weapon reaches 1950% synchronization, Wind and Rain Summoning upgrades to Forbidden Blast Zone, completely blocking enemy critical hits.  

2.6 Legendary Linkage 🔗  

🔹 Adventure Mode:  
- Hitting a target applies "Damage Deepening", increasing damage taken by the enemy.  
- Having this weapon (Essence of Ink - Combine) enhances all melee weapons in the inventory.  

[hr][/hr]

🔹 When 2 legendary weapons are in the inventory:  
- Chrysan Form lasts longer.  
- Left & right clicks increase melee attack speed.  
- In Ink Soul mode:  
  - Bamboo Form: More Ink Spirit area block activations.  
  - Plum Form: Higher chance of Plum Branch triggering.  

[hr][/hr]

🔹 When 3 legendary weapons are in the inventory (Blast & Team Modes):  
- If the weapon is in the back slot and HP drops below a certain threshold, HP will automatically restore to that threshold.

🔥 4.1 Adventure Tips – Essence of Ink 🔥  

🗡️ Essence of Ink is the first legendary melee weapon—a Chinese-style masterpiece with elegant design and deadly power.  

🎯 Want Essence of Ink Instantly?  
💰 If you're aiming for a full upgrade, be prepared to invest some gold. But don’t worry! You can save a lot through:  
- In-game events  
- Recharge events  
- Expert Rush Ticket rewards  

🔔 Good news! This event is permanent, so no need to rush—take your time and build up gradually.  
In other words, when you recharge for Wind God, this recharge will also count for Ink, as well as for new grenades and Grey Core.  
So while obtaining this gun, your top-ups are also counting for Ink!  

⚠️ Just make sure each time you recharge, you spend your points on the event to avoid any bug.  

⚔️ Using Essence of Ink in Adventure Mode  
🔹 Key trick: Use Plum Branch to activate Broken Bamboo—this triggers auto-aim, allowing Essence of Ink to seek enemies automatically and deal massive AoE damage.  
🔹 Perfect for mob clearing (e.g., Island 10, where mobs spawn close together).  

🏆 The Best Support Knife?  
✅ Amplifies the damage of other weapons in your loadout.  
✅ Provides passive background damage and attack boosts when fully upgraded.  
✅ No need to switch weapons—it works passively!  

⚡ Better than DC and Axes? Yes, depending on your needs, but it outshines them as a support weapon!  

✨ Legendary Linkage & Extra Perks  
⭐ Just like Starshatter, Essence of Ink benefits from owning multiple legendary weapons—so your old legendaries still contribute!  
🖋️ Ink Blessing boosts damage against mutants significantly and speeds up knife switching, making combat smoother.  
🔮 Comes with Ultimate & Mutant Stones, granting unique stats and powerful boosts—especially the Mutant variant.  

✨ Why Choose Essence of Ink?  
If you love style, elegance, and purity, this melee weapon is perfect for you! 🌊⚔️  
Not to mention, the automatic change of appearance and visibility without extra cost will shift you to another level of gaming experience.

notes.title: Enter the Dimensional Rift
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/Amo75W7.png


Level Mechanism

https://i.imgur.com/n9vtRbZ.png

1. Level Classification

There are three types of levels in Neon City: main line, side line, and hidden.

Main Line

Consumes 300 stamina each time.
Allows 10 challenges per week.
Team formation is possible.
Rewards: Mutant Crystals, Training Manuals, Synchronization Crystals Lv1 (average reward quality).


Side Line

Unlocks after completing the corresponding main quest.
Consumes 600 stamina per attempt.
Allows 10 challenges per round.
Team formation is possible.
Rewards: Higher quality rewards compared to Main Line. Includes Expert Coins, Synchronization Crystals Lv2, Gold Coins, Hero Gems.


Hidden Level

Special single-player level triggered after winning and successfully escaping a normal level.
Can be challenged once a day. The number resets the next day.
Consumes 1000 stamina per attempt.
Rewards: Rich rewards including Gold or New Legendary Gems.


https://i.imgur.com/G1kjSDT.png

[color=orange]To be honest, the main quest takes a long time, the rewards are average, and the cost-effectiveness is very low. Although the side quest rewards are qualification gems, the drop rate is not high. Therefore, unless you want to obtain the gun spirit training props, it is not worth clearing the level.  
As for the hidden level, it is triggered by chance. I played for 5 hours on Friday without getting any, but on Saturday I played 1 twice and 2 once and it was triggered. The rewards for the hidden level are still very generous. Basically, you can get a gold box for every elite monster you kill. But I don't recommend playing it deliberately.
[/color]

https://i.imgur.com/YTxsSHr.png

2. Level challenge time:

The challenge time for all levels is 30 minutes.[color=red] After entering the battle, an evacuation point will be randomly refreshed in the level every 5 minutes. The evacuation point exists for 30-60 seconds (for example, it appears at 26:00 and disappears at 25:00). [/color] Standing on the evacuation point, you can leave the battle with the props you have obtained, and the challenge will be displayed as successful.

https://i.imgur.com/goMrVxw.png

[color=orange]The advantage of the evacuation point mechanism is that even if you cannot defeat the boss, you can still exit the settlement with the rewards you picked up from killing monsters in the early stage. At the same time, the evacuation point settlement is the first layer of anti-AFK means. Even if you can fight while AFK, if you don't go to the evacuation point, you can't successfully settle.
[/color]

3. Team building for main and side quests:

https://i.imgur.com/zJWAl3N.png

4. Survival Energy System

After entering the battle, the survival energy is displayed in the lower left corner of the interface. It is initially full energy, and it slowly decreases over time from the time you enter the battle, decreasing by 1 bar per minute. If you die in the battle, the survival energy is directly reduced by half. When the survival energy is zero, the level challenge fails.  
After killing a monster, a treasure chest will drop. Picking up the treasure chest will restore survival energy. [color=red]Note that only treasure chests dropped by monsters you killed can be picked up.[/color]  
Treasure chests are divided into gold/purple/blue and other colors. The value of the reward items contained in different colors is different, with blue being the lowest.



4. Survival Energy System

After entering the battle, the survival energy is displayed in the lower left corner of the interface. It is initially full energy, and it slowly decreases over time from the time you enter the battle, decreasing by 1 bar per minute. If you die in the battle, the survival energy is directly reduced by half. When the survival energy is zero, the level challenge fails.  
After killing a monster, a treasure chest will drop. Picking up the treasure chest will restore survival energy. Note that only treasure chests dropped by monsters you killed can be picked up.  
Treasure chests are divided into gold/purple/blue and other colors. The value of the reward items contained in different colors is different, with blue being the lowest.

https://i.imgur.com/YYQxg9d.png

[color=orange]The initial survival energy is 10 grids. Even if you don't kill a monster, as long as you don't die, you can survive until the second evacuation point appears. Therefore, you can let the trumpet carry special damage weapons, and under the protection of the big trumpet, use them specifically to break the shield. Of course, remember the room number and enter halfway.  
Picking up boxes can not only get rewards, but also increase survival energy, but you cannot pick up boxes from monsters that you have not killed. If you don't pick up boxes, you will not get rewards, and the challenge will fail. This is also a mechanism to prevent AFK.[/color]

2. Monster Mechanics
Neon City has a new monster system.

1. Ordinary monsters  
There are 9527, 8820, and Hyena. These three monsters are numerous, have low damage, and have no special skills.  

2. Elite monsters  
There are ghosts, meat mountains, and terraformers. These three monsters have their own unique skills. It is important to note that if you do not carry weapons with special damage types, you cannot kill elite monsters.

https://i.imgur.com/T3NOavE.png

Ghost: Can be invisible, and the player cannot see it at all. Ghost also has a one-hit attack to break invisibility, and the first attack after the invisibility is removed has high damage. At the same time, Ghost has a skill that makes it completely immune to damage. Once released, it will be immune to all damage except for special types of damage.

https://i.imgur.com/AyaHDKR.png

Meat Mountain: A defensive monster that will grow in size over time and increase its base health by 100% (up to 3 times)

https://i.imgur.com/4npZv3Y.png

Transformer: When born and every once in a while after birth, add a layer of damage reduction BUFF to nearby monsters (except Transformers and BOSS) (up to 3 layers of BUFF on monsters). When there are 3 layers, only 1 point of damage will be taken each time. The BUFF of multiple Transformers can be stacked. When all Transformers on the field die, the BUFF will be cleared. Therefore, when Transformers appear on the field, they should be killed first!

https://i.imgur.com/vkZLKeC.png

[color=orange]No matter what your main weapon is, you must carry a weapon with a special damage type, such as plasma or severance. If you don't have a special damage weapon, you will be helpless against elite monsters. This is the third level of anti-hang-up means.  
When the monster is just refreshed, you can kill it instantly, which can save a lot of time. However, once the monster releases a skill, it will be more troublesome.[/color]


3. Boss

Neon City has an endless level mechanism, that is, after killing the boss, the challenge will not be displayed as successful, but the second boss will be refreshed after a period of time. Of course, the refreshed boss is also of the same type.
All bosses have three health bars, with an elemental shield and a flesh shield in the middle of the two health bars, which can only be broken with weapons with plasma damage and severing damage. Similar to the green snake in the Three Fights with the White Bone Demon dungeon.

① City 1-Titan

https://i.imgur.com/GLis4NP.png

[code]Titan will receive an additional layer of damage reduction every time it receives a certain number of damages, up to a maximum of 3 layers. At 3 layers, it will only receive a fixed damage of 99999900[/code]

https://i.imgur.com/vSGycVK.png

[code]If the BOSS hits a stone pillar when charging, it will be dizzy and the number of damage reduction layers will be reduced[/code]

https://i.imgur.com/E6xB7iw.png

[color=orange]The key to killing the Titan is to stand near the stone pillars when attacking the Titan, so that the Titan will automatically crash into the stone pillars when attacking you, thus offsetting the shield.[/color]


② The Walled City 2-Mad Science

https://i.imgur.com/pgjaavf.png

[code]The Mad Scientist will release the Thunderball skill, which will slowly drop a thunderball at the player's location. If hit, the player will be dizzy.
When the thunder ball falls to the ground , it forms a thunder prison swamp, and any player who comes into contact with it will continue to suffer damage
[/code]

https://i.imgur.com/8hhIvwW.png

[code]Every once in a while, the Mad Scientist will lock onto a player and release "Mark Target". After a long period of accumulation, it will cause a fatal blow.
[/code]

https://i.imgur.com/RrGrGIC.png

[color=orange]The damage of the madman's thunder ball is very high, about 300,000-400,000, and there is also a stun effect. The subsequent continuous damage is also more than 100,000, so try not to stay in one place for too long when fighting a madman.[/color]

③The Walled City 3-Hackers

https://i.imgur.com/3ZBb3s1.png

[code]Every time you cast a skill, a gem will appear and the player can pick it up.
Players can only cause damage to the BOSS if they carry gems of the same color as the BOSS's shield.
The boss's barrage will not cause damage to players carrying gems with the barrage color.
[color=red]That is: the same color cannot cause damage, nor can it be damaged by walls[/color][/code]

https://i.imgur.com/JlV6CLz.png

[code]Every once in a while, the boss will charge up, and then cause different damage effects based on the difference in the number of the two gems on the player.
Every once in a while the BOSS will enter an invincible state and then clear the gems on the field. Each white gem will restore health, and each purple gem will cause damage to the player.
[/code]
[color=orange]This girl holding an umbrella is quite annoying, mainly because the colors on her body change too quickly, and the gems on the ground are scattered so densely that sometimes you can't eat what you want, and you accidentally get what you don't want. So, instead of caring about the color, it's better to eat it all and kill it directly.[/color]
3. Brief Analysis of the Blade and Soul System

The most eye-catching update in the new chapter is the addition of the Gun Spirit system, and the most tempting announcement is this sentence: " Gun Spirits may be added to other adventure mode battles in the future, so stay tuned! "
Simply put, a gun spirit is a summoned creature that can assist you in fighting in a dungeon!

1. How to obtain the gun spirit

Gun spirits can be directly extracted through summoning stones, or synthesized through fragments.
To obtain it through the summoning stone, you need to enter the Neon City interface and click the summon below to enter.

https://i.imgur.com/KNVW6Ym.png

If you draw 80 times, you will definitely get an orange-level gun spirit, and if you draw 160 times, you will definitely get a colored-level gun spirit.

https://i.imgur.com/89VucFk.png

Summoning stones can be purchased through the event interface, or dropped in the Neon City dungeon (with a lower chance of dropping)

https://i.imgur.com/Wx5SuLn.png
[color=orange]In other words, if you spend 16,000 gold coins, you will definitely get the colorful "Starship" gun spirit. According to the past practice of "Shark", this kind of thing is purchased at a discount when it is first released, and double the purchase price after the event. Therefore, it is recommended that players with strength get the Starship directly.[/color]

2. Attributes of Gun Spirit

Currently, gun spirits are divided into four categories: color, orange, purple, and blue. The color attribute is the best, but currently only one character, Starship, is open.
Click on the obtained Gun Spirit in the Gun Spirit interface to see detailed attribute descriptions.

https://i.imgur.com/rS7ZwAJ.png

Below the level is the basic attribute of the current gun spirit, which will increase as the gun spirit is upgraded.
After clicking on the proficient weapon, you can view the main weapon type that the gun spirit is proficient in. Only by giving the gun spirit the firearm it is proficient in can it deal maximum damage.
The circle on the upper right is the holy object that the gun spirit can carry.
Combat skills are skills that the gun spirit can release in addition to normal attacks. Skill damage all has special damage types.

[Color=yellow]In addition, it should be noted that only starships can carry two sets of weapons, while other gun spirits can only carry one set.[/color]

https://i.imgur.com/w2sqRd5.png

https://i.imgur.com/L3ubdcZ.png

3. The role of the gun spirit

After clicking on the Gun Spirit to go into battle, the Gun Spirit will follow the player into the battle of Neon City and release its own skills to kill monsters.

https://i.imgur.com/gdOX7ip.png

The main weapon carried by the gun spirit will float beside the gun spirit.  
The damage of the gun spirit is closely related to the weapons equipped by the player. The better the weapons and the higher the level of training, the higher the damage of the gun spirit.  

Some players may ask: If the Gun Spirit is equipped with a weapon with a damage type, can the Gun Spirit's damage break the boss's shield?  

[color=red]After testing, it cannot! I equipped the Gun Spirit with the Final Rage of Severing attribute, but it cannot break the meat shield.[/color]

https://i.imgur.com/pOEP8Nx.png


[color=red]But! The gun spirit's own skill attribute can break the shield!.[/color]

https://i.imgur.com/3kFaKsV.png

That is to say, when you carry a weapon with plasma attributes, such as Fu Hu, you can use a gun spirit with tearing attributes to break the meat shield.

4. Sacred Objects

Each gun spirit corresponds to a holy relic. When the gun spirit is upgraded to level 3, the holy relic will be automatically opened without the need to obtain it specifically.
Holy relics can also be strengthened, and strengthening holy relics can increase a large amount of blood shield.

IV. Summary of the Mechanism


[color=orange]The overall difficulty of the new chapter is relatively high.[/color] You cannot pass the level by just meeting the damage requirement. You also need the support of survival attributes.

Weaker players can skip the boss fight and leave through the [color=blue]evacuation point[/color] after clearing the first wave of monsters. They can obtain:
    - Mutation Crystals
    - Training Books
    - Synchronization Crystals
    - Precious gems like [color=gold]Gold and Legend[/color]
    - Rare items such as Expert Coins, Summoning Stones, and Breakthrough Materials.

Rewards:
    - [color=green]Side quest rewards[/color] are better than main quests.
    - [color=purple]Hidden level rewards[/color] are better than side quests.
    - [color=orange]Hidden levels[/color] are triggered by probability, and the main quest offers a higher chance of triggering them.

[color=red]Preparation is key:[/color] Although the chapter is not cost-effective currently, many items can only be obtained through this method. Capable players should act early and stockpile resources.

Elite monsters:
    - Each wave includes elite monsters like Meat Mountain, Ghost, and Transformer.
    - These monsters require [color=orange]special damage weapons[/color] (Plasma, Rupture) to defeat.
    - [color=red]Tip:[/color] Kill Transformers first as they buff other monsters with damage immunity.

Boss mechanics:
    - All bosses have [color=orange]two special shields[/color]: one for Plasma damage and one for Rupture damage.
    - [color=red]Weapon Recommendations:[/color]
        - Main: Immortal Star Core (Rupture), Doomsday Crossbow (Rupture)
        - Secondary: Fu Hu (Plasma), Han Tian (Rip), Huan Cai (Plasma)

[color=blue]Sword Spirits:[/color]
    - Auxiliary combat units that can be upgraded and equipped with weapons.
    - They can have their life shields increased through relics.
    - Key details:
        - Sword Spirits attack independently of their carried weapons.
        - They can break boss shields with their [color=orange]special type of damage.[/color]
        - Low-level Sword Spirits require further training to deal significant damage.

[color=green]Best Sword Spirits:[/color]
    - [color=orange]Starship:[/color] Can be obtained for a guaranteed 16,000 gold coins.
    - Titan (Rupture) and Madman (Plasma): Can be obtained for around 8,000 gold coins.
    - [color=red]Recommendation:[/color] Players with resources should get Starship during the event. Sword Spirits will likely be useful in more gameplay modes in the future.


[color=orange]Tip:[/color] Carrying an upgraded Sword Spirit could feel like having an automatic attack companion. Imagine the fun of 2 vs 1 battles!

notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce the arrival of the latest addition to our game: eXclusive X. This innovative update introduces a special tab within the game, inspired by our Discord VIP and online store, offering players access to exclusive weapons and items for a limited time based on their in-game performance.

This exciting feature brings with it three distinct currencies:


 Donates Blue: exclusively obtained from ladder solo league only.
 Donates Orange: exclusively obtained from Expert Rush, Expert Leagues, or other adventure events.
 Donates Red: Coming soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43887664/2cb47ce71ca116aed09426b733f86b64d68d4aa9.png


The store can be extended to include new features in the future. The Expert rush season 9 will start this Saturday, make sure to empty warehouses; ladder rewards will be announced tonight or tomorrow, so get ready!
In order to start collecting these amazing currencies we will introduce the 2 available monthly modes : Expert Rush and Ladder Solo League.
